message.content:
<SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
Brad has identified a promising time slot: Thursday at 10:00 AM. He's correct that Priya, Marcus, and David are free at that time. Only Elena has a conflict, which is a 'Hiring panel'. This is an internal meeting and might be flexible.

Brad has asked me to reach out to see if the meeting can be moved. However, I don't have the ability to contact the partners directly or to see the details of their calendar entries beyond what `read_calendar` provides. I also cannot send emails. This is a task for Brad.

I need to respond to Brad, letting him know that I agree with his suggestion, but he will have to be the one to reach out to Elena or her assistant to inquire about moving the 'Hiring panel' meeting. My role is to find the open slots for my partners and book the meeting once a time is confirmed.

So, I will append a message to the workspace confirming my agreement and clarifying our roles.
</SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>

function.name: append_workspace
function.arguments: {"text":"Hi Brad. That sounds like a great plan. Thursday at 10:00 AM works for both Priya and Marcus. I am unable to contact any of the partners, so can you please reach out to see if Elena's hiring panel can be moved? If she can make it, I'll go ahead and book the meeting. Let me know how it goes."}
